context.purpose: exact checked RAM/VRAM/temp formula, full-width and X-tile plans, buffer lifetime contract and pre-set read-amplification bounds for the selected v2 architecture

selected_inputs.gate3: reservoir_sigma_clip R=64, candidate = 24 B (x double, b double, frame_order uint64)
selected_inputs.gate4: fp64 accumulators; confidence adds B_c/S_c/C_c = 3 doubles + degraded counter per pixel/channel
selected_inputs.gate2: fold output + four independent area fractions + support flags per native output pixel

deferred: multiband halo radius decided in gate 9; the plan exposes halo_rows_per_band_edge and reserves the role now
local warp grids are a gate-8 buffer role; not in this formula
resume/index metadata byte sizes are gate-7 inputs passed as host_fixed

device_per_pixel_roles.note: per target pixel per channel unless marked per_pixel
device_per_pixel_roles.frame_planes: 2 doubles = 16 B (frame A/B of the in-flight frame)
device_per_pixel_roles.confidence: 3 doubles + 8 B counter = 32 B (B_c, S_c, C_c, conf_degraded)
device_per_pixel_roles.fold_staging: 3 doubles = 24 B (folded A_out, B_out, B2_out per profile slot)

device_fixed_roles.source_device_slots: source_device_slots x source_slot_device_bytes (in-flight normalized source frames)
device_fixed_roles.device_reserve: geometry parameters, fold scratch, streams/events, CUDA allocator reserve - caller-proved bound

host_roles.lifetime_contract: slot counts bound the concurrently resident (frame,band) views - NOT frame_count; a (frame,band) view is read once and pinned across all X-tiles (section 17.2)
host_roles.host_fixed: reader caches, output staging, resume/index metadata, codec scratch, margin

tile_plan.order: full-width band first; X-tiling only when the device cannot hold even one full-width padded row
tile_plan.n_independence: tile_cols and device per-pixel bytes must not depend on frame_count; frame_count never enters the device formula and enters the host side only through caller-proved per-row byte bounds, not slot counts
tile_plan.halo: band core rows + 2*halo_rows_per_band_edge padded rows per band; halo adds padded rows, not re-reads
tile_plan.min_tile_cols: a plan whose tile_cols shrinks with growing frame_count violates the contract; verified by a 40 vs 600 frame plan equality test

read_amplification.counters_required: section 17.2 counter set; the planner only computes the pre-set bound check
read_amplification.model: source views read once per (frame,band) and pinned across X-tiles; predicted_application_ra = (target_height + 2*halo*n_bands) / target_height; X-tiling does not multiply source or quality reads

gates.violation: predicted ra above the bound makes the plan infeasible

infeasible_when: device cannot hold one padded row at tile_cols >= 1
host cannot hold the pinned slots for one padded row
predicted read amplification exceeds its bound
fallback_and_feasibility.fallback_tile: smallest feasible tile_cols x band_rows; feasibility never silently drops halo or slots

test_matrix: role table arithmetic: exact per-pixel byte count for R=64/3ch and MONO
full-width plan on production geometry 7868x4540 vs known budgets
N-independence: identical tile_cols for 40 and 600 frames
host slots bound band_rows; frame_count does not shrink tile_cols
X-tile fallback when one full-width row exceeds device budget
overflow: SIZE_MAX budgets/inputs cannot wrap into a false feasible
read-amplification bound rejection when halo makes predicted ra exceed the bound
halo accounting: padded rows charged once, band core rows reported
infeasible inputs: zero slots, zero budgets, bad channels
